description: This PHP source file defines the OAuth2ClientsController class, which extends SugarController and manages OAuth2 client-related actions within the SuiteCRM system. The class includes methods for processing user access and rendering specific views for editing passwords, credentials, and authorization codes.

classes.name: OAuth2ClientsController
classes.description: Controller class managing OAuth2 client operations in SuiteCRM, extending SugarController.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Checks if the current user is an admin and sets access rights before invoking the parent process method.

methods.name: action_EditViewPassword
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' for the password editing interface.

methods.name: action_EditViewCredentials
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' for the credentials editing interface.

methods.name: action_EditViewAuthorizationCode
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' for the authorization code editing interface.
